```bash
mkdir -p .agents/research
```

**Current Flow**

The frontend is split across two separate credentials:

- Session auth is enforced globally by [`dashboard/app/components/auth-gate.tsx`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/components/auth-gate.tsx#L6) via `AuthGate()`. It only checks `localStorage["observo_session_token"]`, and only `/signup` is public.
- Dashboard data auth uses API keys from [`dashboard/app/lib/api.ts`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/lib/api.ts#L13) via `buildHeaders()`, which sends `X-API-Key`.
- Account key management uses the session token from [`dashboard/app/lib/api.ts`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/lib/api.ts#L30) via `buildSessionHeaders()`, which sends `Authorization: Bearer ...`.

Signup verification stores both:
- [`dashboard/app/signup/page.tsx`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/signup/page.tsx#L41) `verifyAccount()` sets the API key with `setApiKey(data.api_key)` and writes `observo_session_token` to `localStorage`.

Setup only stores the API key:
- [`dashboard/app/setup/page.tsx`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/setup/page.tsx#L34) `handleConnect()` validates the key and persists it through `setApiKey()`, but never creates a session.

**Findings**

1. The main auth loop bug is in [`dashboard/app/components/auth-gate.tsx`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/components/auth-gate.tsx#L8). `PUBLIC_ROUTES` only includes `/signup`, so `/setup` is blocked unless a session token already exists. That conflicts with the intended recovery flow, because users with only an API key are sent to `/signup` instead of `/setup`.

2. The onboarding UI explicitly points users to `/setup`, but the gate blocks that route. See [`dashboard/app/components/onboarding.tsx`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/components/onboarding.tsx#L242) and [`dashboard/app/components/sidebar.tsx`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/components/sidebar.tsx#L102). This is the clearest frontend loop.

3. The app uses session auth for access control, but API key auth for almost all data. That mismatch means users can be “authenticated” yet unable to load tenant data, or have a valid API key yet be rejected by the gate. The split is visible in [`dashboard/app/components/auth-gate.tsx`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/components/auth-gate.tsx#L18) versus [`dashboard/app/lib/api.ts`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/lib/api.ts#L21).

4. When the API key is missing, the dashboard tends to degrade into fake “demo mode” instead of routing users back into setup. See [`dashboard/app/page.tsx`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/page.tsx#L184) and [`dashboard/app/components/error-state.tsx`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/components/error-state.tsx#L41). Any fetch error is treated as “backend not connected,” which masks auth/setup problems.

5. The sidebar “logout” only clears the API key, not the session token. [`dashboard/app/components/sidebar.tsx`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/components/sidebar.tsx#L93) calls `clearApiKey()`, and [`dashboard/app/lib/api-key-context.tsx`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/lib/api-key-context.tsx#L58) only removes `observo_api_key`. That leaves the user session active and can strand them in a session-only state.

6. There is no frontend `/reset-password` route under `dashboard/app`. But the backend already emails links to that page in [`server/observo_server/emailer.py`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/server/observo_server/emailer.py#L38), and exposes reset endpoints in [`server/observo_server/routers/auth.py`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/server/observo_server/routers/auth.py#L405).

7. There is also no frontend login page, even though the backend exposes [`POST /api/v1/auth/user/login`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/server/observo_server/routers/auth.py#L350). Right now the frontend is effectively signup-only.

8. Public auth pages still render the full app shell because [`dashboard/app/layout.tsx`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/layout.tsx#L26) always includes the sidebar/topbar, and [`dashboard/app/components/client-providers.tsx`](/Users/romirjain/Desktop/building%20projects/Observo/dashboard/app/components/client-providers.tsx#L13) wraps everything in the gate. That’s not the core bug, but it makes onboarding/auth states harder to reason about.
